People: Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley (author, Wikidata Q47152), died 1851; Dionysius Lardner (editor, Wikidata Q905875), died 1859. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Shelley, Mary Wollstonecraft, 1797-1851; Lardner, Dionysius, 1793-1859 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Lives of the most eminent literary and scientific men of France, London : Printed for Longman, Orme, Brown, Green & Longmans ... and John Taylor, 1838-1839, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/livesofmostemine01sheliala. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 87%, 85%, 93% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
